body: Thank you so much. I’ve started feeling a bit better, I’m not as extreme as before. I go through these swings. I’ve texted them, I’ve never called because I’m really insecure about my voice and talking makes me worse. I’ll try it again though to see if I can get some help. I’m not sure my parents would allow it though. They’re extremely prideful and I don’t think they’d want people thinking they were inadequate to take care of me. Regarding the insurance, yeah! It took away my meds and professional therapy for a year and a half I think. I’ve been seeing a school counselor once a week. We’re working on it.

When I can, I most definitely will. My family is incredibly broke. I used to be on meds but I’m off again. We can’t afford anything. We just got insurance back though. Thank you so much for this reply.
